description: This file is the __init__.py module for the torch.fx package, importing and exposing key functions, classes, and constants related to PyTorch's FX toolkit for symbolic tracing, graph representation, and module transformations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the FX computational graph, corresponding to a function call, attribute access, or other operation within the graph.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents the intermediate representation (IR) of a traced module, capturing operations and data flow.

classes.name: GraphModule
classes.description: Wraps a Graph object as a PyTorch nn.Module, enabling code generation and module transformation.

classes.name: Interpreter
classes.description: Facilitates interpretation of a Graph in a dynamic or static context.

classes.name: Transformer
classes.description: Provides transformation capabilities over FX graphs, allowing modifications and optimizations.

methods.name: symbolic_trace
methods.description: Performs symbolic tracing of an nn.Module, producing a Graph representation.

methods.name: Tracer
methods.description: Base class for tracing models to produce FX graphs.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a function so that it can be used safely within FX transformations.

methods.name: replace_pattern
methods.description: Replaces subgraphs matching a pattern with a specified replacement.

methods.name: has_side_effect
methods.description: Determines if a node or operation has side effects.

methods.name: map_arg
methods.description: Applies a function to a node argument.
